rules.statement: A testator's will can create a fidei commissum by directing that certain lands shall be the inheritance of a devisee and prohibiting any individual within three generations from selling, mortgaging, or gifting such lands.
rules.supporting_quote: "As for the aforementioned lands, neither I, nor my five sons, nor the children of my five sons, that is to say, no individual of the said three generations, may sell, mortgage, or gift any of the same; only the power to enjoy and develop the same is reserved to them."
